::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 1st 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Devon Record Office, Exeter 53/10/9/4
:::

My dear Madam

I am very sorry that [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd) was so disappointing.  He might as well have looked at the drawings  I have been waiting to hear from [Mr Ward](organizations/other_236.qmd), 67 Chandos St, Covent Garden  He will gladly see you, and I sent him the MS of the Bear and the Goblin.[^1]  You had better make an appointment with him mentioning my name;  and shew him some of your drawings  I think it might lead to something as his line is illustration

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: 'The Bear and the Goblin' was a poem by Francis Dawson.  CMY was trying to help this illustrator, who had evidently illustrated it, get commissions from publishers.
